name: Phishing Triage
description: Automated phishing alert triage: enrich sender/URL, notify SOC, and close low-confidence cases.
author: AiSOC

name: Ransomware Response
description: Immediate containment and investigation workflow for ransomware detections.

params.message_template: Ransomware detected on {{alert.host}}. Host isolated. Ticket created.

author: AiSOC

name: ATO: Credential Stuffing — Block & Reset
description: Triggered by high-volume failed logins from a single source. Blocks the IP range, identifies impacted users, and forces resets.
author: AiSOC

name: ATO: Impossible Travel — Block & Reset
description: Triggered by impossible-travel detections. Blocks the source IP, force-revokes active sessions for the user, and requires human approval before forcing a password reset.

params.message_template: Suspicious sign-in from {{alert.source_ip}} blocked. Reset your password.

author: AiSOC

name: ATO: MFA Fatigue — Challenge & Reset
description: Triggered when a user receives an unusual burst of MFA prompts. Enforces step-up auth and resets MFA factors after approval.

params.message_template: We've challenged your sign-in due to repeated MFA prompts. Approve only if you initiated.

author: AiSOC

name: ATO: Session Token Theft — Revoke & Isolate
description: Triggered when an authenticated session is observed from a new device + new geo simultaneously. Revokes all tokens and isolates the originating endpoint if known.

params.message_template: Session theft suspected for {{alert.user}}. Tokens revoked, host {{alert.host}} isolated.

author: AiSOC

name: ATO: Suspicious OAuth Grant — Revoke & Investigate
description: Triggered when a user grants a new OAuth scope to an unfamiliar third-party app. Revokes the grant and investigates.

params.message_template: Removed OAuth grant for {{alert.oauth_client_app_name}}. Re-add only if intentional.

author: AiSOC

name: Anomalous Data Transfer: DLP / Exfiltration Response
description: Triggered by a DLP or UEBA alert detecting an anomalously large or out-of-policy data transfer, potential exfiltration to external destination, or sensitive data leaving the organization. Correlates evidence, blocks destination if malicious, and disables the user if compromise is confirmed.

steps.name: Search SIEM for prior data transfer activity by user
Search SIEM for other users transferring to same destination

params.message: Block destination IP '{{inputs.destination_ip}}' involved in anomalous data transfer ({{inputs.data_volume_mb}}MB, classification: {{inputs.data_classification}})?
Disable account for '{{inputs.user}}' due to suspected data exfiltration ({{inputs.data_volume_mb}}MB of {{inputs.data_classification}} data to {{inputs.destination_ip}})?

steps.name: Revoke all active sessions for user

params.message_template: Anomalous data transfer by {{inputs.user}}: {{inputs.data_volume_mb}}MB of {{inputs.data_classification}} data via {{inputs.transfer_protocol}} to {{inputs.destination_ip}}. Destination blocked: {{context.block_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: BEC: Conditional Access Policy Bypass
description: Triggered when a BEC-related sign-in succeeds from a region that should be blocked by Conditional Access. Restores policy.
author: AiSOC

name: BEC: Impersonation Domain Quarantine
description: Triggered when an inbound email originates from a domain that look-alikes an executive or vendor. Quarantines and blocks.
author: AiSOC

name: BEC: Malicious Inbox Rule Removed
description: Triggered when a forwarding/filter rule is created that hides vendor or finance keywords. Removes the rule and resets creds.

params.message_template: BEC rule removed for {{alert.user}}. Validate any vendor changes in the last 7d.

author: AiSOC

name: BEC: M365 / Workspace Token Theft
description: Triggered when a refresh token is observed from a new ASN with no interactive sign-in. Revokes refresh tokens and forces MFA.

params.message_template: Refresh-token theft suspected for {{alert.user}}. Tokens revoked.

author: AiSOC

name: BEC: Vendor Payment Redirect — Freeze
description: Triggered when a vendor banking detail change happens via email. Freezes pending payments and pages CFO.
author: AiSOC

name: Brute Force: Account Lockout and Source Block
description: Triggered by detection of repeated failed authentication attempts (password spray, credential stuffing, RDP/SSH brute force). Locks out the targeted account, blocks the source IP, and triggers investigation.

steps.name: Enrich source IP (threat intel, reputation, ASN)
Search SIEM for prior activity from attacking IP
Block attacking source IP at perimeter
Approval gate — temporarily disable targeted account

params.message: Temporarily disable account '{{inputs.user}}' due to brute-force attack ({{inputs.failure_count}} failures from {{inputs.source_ip}})?

steps.name: Revoke active sessions for targeted user
Create SIEM notable event for brute force campaign

params.message_template: Brute force alert: {{inputs.attack_type}} from {{inputs.source_ip}} against {{inputs.target_service}} ({{inputs.failure_count}} failures). IP blocked: {{context.block_success}}. User disabled: {{context.disable_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Cloud ATO: Compromised Cloud Account Response
description: Triggered by anomalous API activity, impossible travel, or cloud CSPM alert indicating a compromised cloud account. Revokes active sessions, rotates credentials, preserves audit trail, and notifies cloud security team.

steps.name: Search cloud audit trail for recent actions
Approval gate — revoke cloud sessions and keys

params.message: Revoke all active sessions and access keys for cloud user '{{inputs.cloud_user}}' ({{inputs.cloud_provider}})?

params.message_template: Cloud ATO: {{inputs.cloud_user}} on {{inputs.cloud_provider}}. Sessions revoked: {{context.revoke_success}}. Source IP blocked: {{inputs.source_ip}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Cloud: Azure Blob Container Public
description: Triggered when an Azure Storage container is set to public. Reverts to private and audits.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: CloudTrail Disabled — Re-enable
description: Triggered when a CloudTrail trail is stopped. Restarts trail and audits API calls in the dark window.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: Unexpected Cross-Account Trust
description: Triggered when a role trust policy adds an external account ID not on the allow-list. Revokes and audits.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: GKE Cluster Anonymous Auth
description: Triggered when GKE cluster is configured to allow anonymous Kubernetes API access. Disables anonymous and audits.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: Over-Privileged IAM — Detach & Review
description: Triggered when IAM Access Analyzer flags an over-privileged role. Detaches the policy and opens an owner-review ticket.

params.message_template: Policy {{alert.policy}} detached from {{alert.role}}. Re-add only the minimum needed.

author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: Cloud Access Key Leaked
description: Triggered when a long-lived access key is found in a public repo or paste site. Rotates the key and scans for downstream use.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: Root Account MFA Disabled
description: Triggered when root MFA is disabled. Re-enables MFA and pages the cloud-platform owner immediately.

params.message_template: Root MFA was disabled — re-enabled. Investigate {{alert.actor}}.

author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
description: Triggered when an RDS instance toggles to publicly accessible. Removes public access and audits.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: S3 Bucket Public — Re-private & Audit
description: Triggered by `s3-public-bucket` detection. Sets bucket private, enables Block Public Access, and audits last 7d access logs.
author: AiSOC

name: Cloud: Security Group Opens 0.0.0.0/0
description: Triggered when a security group rule allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to a sensitive port. Closes the rule and audits the change.
author: AiSOC

name: Container Escape: Runtime Breach Response
description: Triggered by container runtime security alert (Falco, Sysdig, or similar) indicating a container escape attempt or successful breakout to the host. Kills the offending container, isolates the node, and preserves evidence.

steps.name: Cordon Kubernetes node (prevent new pod scheduling)
Approval gate — isolate the Kubernetes node

params.message: Network-isolate node '{{inputs.node_host}}'? This will drain all pods and may impact running workloads.

params.message_template: Container escape on node {{inputs.node_host}} (pod: {{inputs.pod_name}}, ns: {{inputs.namespace}}). Container killed: {{context.kill_success}}. Node isolated: {{context.isolate_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Exfil: Archive File Egress (.zip / .7z / .rar)
description: Triggered when a host uploads an archive to an external dest. Holds the file in DLP review queue and notifies user's manager.

params.message_template: Archive upload by {{alert.user}} to {{alert.dst_host}} queued for DLP review.

author: AiSOC

name: Exfil: DNS Tunneling
description: Triggered by high-entropy DNS query length on a host. Sinkholes the suspect domain and isolates the host.
author: AiSOC

name: Exfil: Large Outbound Upload
description: Triggered when a host uploads >X GB to a non-corporate destination in a short window. Blocks destination and investigates.
author: AiSOC

name: Exfil: Personal Cloud Storage Upload
description: Triggered when corporate data uploads to a personal cloud (personal Drive, Dropbox, iCloud). Blocks dest, manager notify.
author: AiSOC

name: Exfil: Sensitive Data to Removable Media
description: Triggered when a sensitive file is written to a USB volume. Blocks USB writes via EDR policy and opens a ticket.

params.message_template: Sensitive write to USB by {{alert.user}}. Host USB now read-only.

author: AiSOC

name: DDoS: DNS Amplification
description: Triggered when an inbound spike of crafted DNS queries hits an authoritative server. Sinkholes spoofed sources.
author: AiSOC

name: DDoS: Application Layer L7
description: Triggered by anomalous L7 request rate or pattern. Engages WAF rate-limit rule and challenge-page.

params.message_template: L7 DDoS on {{alert.target}}. WAF rate-limit + challenge on.

author: AiSOC

name: DDoS: Auth-Endpoint Credential Stuffing
description: Triggered when /login takes a sustained spike of failed attempts. Combines DDoS + credential-stuffing response: WAF challenge, rate-limit, source-IP block.
author: AiSOC

name: DDoS: SYN Flood
description: Triggered by SYN flood pattern at edge. Enables SYN cookies and increases backend capacity.

params.message_template: SYN flood on {{alert.target}}. SYN cookies + scale-out.

author: AiSOC

name: DDoS: Volumetric L3/L4
description: Triggered by volumetric flood detection at edge. Engages scrubbing provider and pages on-call.
author: AiSOC

name: Endpoint Isolation: EDR-Driven Host Quarantine
description: Triggered when an endpoint requires emergency isolation due to confirmed or high-confidence compromise (ransomware spread, active C2 communication, lateral movement staging). Uses EDR to network-isolate the host while preserving management connectivity, collects forensic artifacts, and notifies the SOC.

steps.name: Enrich host asset context and existing alerts
Search SIEM for lateral movement indicators from this host

params.query: src_host={{inputs.host}} AND (event_type=lateral_movement OR event_type=credential_dump OR event_type=network_scan)

params.message: Network-isolate endpoint '{{inputs.host}}' (user: {{inputs.user}}) due to {{inputs.compromise_type}}? This will cut all network connectivity except EDR management channel.

steps.name: Block IOC hash globally across fleet
Run AV scan on isolated host
Notify SOC team and endpoint owner

params.message_template: Endpoint '{{inputs.host}}' isolated due to {{inputs.compromise_type}} (user: {{inputs.user}}). Forensics collected: {{context.forensics_success}}. IOC blocked: {{context.block_ioc_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: IDS/IPS Critical Alert: Network Intrusion Response
description: Triggered by an IDS/IPS signature at critical severity indicating active exploitation, C2 communication, or lateral movement detected at the network layer. Enriches source IP, blocks traffic, and escalates.

steps.name: Search SIEM for prior activity from source IP
Approval gate — isolate targeted internal host

params.message: Isolate internal host '{{inputs.destination_ip}}' targeted by IDS/IPS critical alert (sig: {{inputs.signature}})?

steps.name: Create SIEM notable event for IDS critical

params.message_template: IDS Critical: {{inputs.signature}} from {{inputs.source_ip}} targeting {{inputs.destination_ip}}. Source IP blocked: {{context.block_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Insider: Anomalous After-Hours Access
description: Triggered when a user accesses sensitive systems outside their normal pattern. Step-up MFA and log for HR review.
author: AiSOC

name: Insider: Mass File Download
description: Triggered when a single user downloads >N files from a sensitive store in <T window. Reduces user permissions and notifies manager.
author: AiSOC

name: Insider: Privilege Misuse
description: Triggered when a privileged account performs actions outside its approved JIT window. Revokes privilege and pages HR-Sec.
author: AiSOC

name: Insider: Resignation + Sensitive Access
description: Triggered when a user with a recent resignation flag accesses sensitive data. Read-only mode and HR audit.

params.message_template: Resigning user {{alert.user}} accessed sensitive data. Read-only enforced.

author: AiSOC

name: Insider: Source-Code Exfil
description: Triggered when a developer pushes private source to a personal remote or pastebin-like target. Blocks dest, pages eng-leadership.
author: AiSOC

name: Lateral: Cross-Domain Movement
description: Triggered when an account from one trust domain authenticates to an asset in a separately-classified domain in a way that violates policy. Segments the network and investigates.
author: AiSOC

name: Lateral: Kerberoasting
description: Triggered by abnormal SPN-ticket request volume from a single user. Resets impacted service-account credentials.
author: AiSOC

name: Lateral: Pass-The-Hash
description: Triggered by NTLM relay / PTH detection. Disables the user and isolates source + destination.
author: AiSOC

name: Lateral: PsExec / Remote Service Creation
description: Triggered by remote service creation patterns indicative of PsExec / Impacket. Isolates target and source, investigates.
author: AiSOC

name: Lateral: RDP Spray
description: Triggered when one host opens RDP to >N hosts in <T window. Blocks the source IP, isolates host, investigates.
author: AiSOC

name: Malware Execution: Detection & Containment
description: Triggered by EDR alert for confirmed or suspected malware execution (trojan, infostealer, dropper, RAT). Quarantines the host, kills the malicious process, collects evidence, and notifies the SOC.

steps.name: Run full AV scan on host

params.message: Isolate host '{{inputs.host}}' from network due to confirmed malware execution?

steps.name: Block malicious hash as global IOC

params.message_template: Malware execution on {{inputs.host}} (user: {{inputs.user}}). File quarantined: {{context.quarantine_success}}. Host isolated: {{context.isolate_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Network Containment: Segment Isolation Response
description: Triggered by an alert requiring network-level containment of a host or subnet. Coordinates firewall/security-group rule changes to block lateral movement while preserving forensics and management access.

steps.name: Enrich host reputation and asset context
Search SIEM for outbound connections from host

params.message: Apply network containment for '{{inputs.host_or_subnet}}'? This will block all east-west traffic except management access.

steps.name: Block inbound traffic to host via security group
Block outbound traffic from host via security group
Collect network flow evidence before isolation completes

params.message_template: Network containment applied for {{inputs.host_or_subnet}} (threat: {{inputs.threat_type}}). Inbound blocked: {{context.block_inbound_success}}. Outbound blocked: {{context.block_outbound_success}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Phishing: Email Investigation & Remediation
description: Triggered by a phishing alert from email gateway or user report. Extracts IOCs, retracts the message fleet-wide, blocks sender domain, and resets any credentials that may have been compromised.

params.message: Block sender domain '{{inputs.sender_domain}}' at email gateway and DNS firewall?

steps.name: Check if recipient clicked link / opened attachment
Approval gate — force password reset (if click detected)

params.message: Recipient '{{inputs.recipient_user}}' may have clicked link. Force password reset + MFA?

params.message_template: Phishing alert: {{inputs.sender_domain}} → {{inputs.recipient_user}}. Message retracted: {{context.retract_success}}. Domain blocked: {{context.domain_blocked}}.

author: Beenu - beenu@cyble.com

name: Privilege Escalation: Detection & Containment
description: Triggered by EDR or SIEM alert for privilege escalation activity (sudo abuse, token impersonation, LSASS dump, UAC bypass, etc.). Collects forensics, disables the account if confirmed malicious, and escalates to Tier-2 for post-exploitation review.

steps.name: Search SIEM for prior activity by this user on this host
Run AV / EDR scan on host
Collect forensic evidence via EDR script

params.message: Disable user account '{{inputs.user}}' due to privilege escalation on '{{inputs.host}}'?

steps.name: Revoke all active sessions for user

name: Ransomware: File-Server Encryption Activity

author: AiSOC

name: Ransomware: Host Isolation & Snapshot
description: Immediate host isolation, disk snapshot for forensics, page on-call. Standard first-response for endpoint ransomware.
author: AiSOC

name: Ransomware: Internet-Exposed Asset Containment
description: Triggered when a host with public exposure shows ransomware indicators. Pulls the asset off the internet immediately.

params.message_template: Internet-exposed host {{alert.host}} pulled off-net. Ransomware suspected.

author: AiSOC

name: Ransomware: Shadow Copy Deletion Detected
description: Triggered on `vssadmin delete shadows` or wmic shadowcopy delete. Pre-encryption signal — isolate fast and verify backups.
author: AiSOC

name: Supply Chain: GitHub Action Compromise
description: Triggered when a referenced GitHub Action SHA changes unexpectedly or matches a compromise advisory. Pin to last-known-good and audit.
author: AiSOC

name: Supply Chain: IaC Drift Detected
description: Triggered when production infra deviates from IaC source of truth in a security-relevant way. Reverts to declared state.
author: AiSOC

name: Supply Chain: Malicious npm Package
description: Triggered when a published npm package matches a known-bad list. Blocks installs at registry-mirror, audits org installs.
author: AiSOC

name: Supply Chain: PyPI Typosquat
description: Triggered when a typosquat package is observed in CI installs. Pulls install lock to canonical name and audits.
author: AiSOC

name: Supply Chain: Vendor Breach Notification
description: Triggered when a vendor publishes a breach advisory matching internal vendor inventory. Blocks vendor IPs, opens procurement review.

params.message_template: Vendor {{alert.vendor}} breach. IPs blocked. Review contracts and integrations.

author: AiSOC

name: Suspicious Sign-In: Anomalous Authentication Response
description: Triggered by identity provider or SIEM alert for a suspicious sign-in event (impossible travel, new device, unknown location, off-hours, anomalous behavior score). Verifies legitimacy, enforces MFA step-up, and disables if confirmed malicious.

steps.name: Enrich source IP geo and threat intel
Search SIEM for recent sign-in history for this user
Force step-up MFA challenge for user
Approval gate — disable user account (if confirmed compromise)

params.message: Disable account for '{{inputs.user}}'? Sign-in from {{inputs.country}} (IP: {{inputs.source_ip}}, risk: {{inputs.risk_score}}). Only if confirmed malicious.

steps.name: Block source IP if confirmed malicious

params.message_template: Suspicious sign-in for {{inputs.user}} from {{inputs.country}} (IP: {{inputs.source_ip}}, risk: {{inputs.risk_score}}). MFA forced: {{context.mfa_success}}. Sessions revoked: {{context.revoke_success}}.

steps.name: Trigger AV / malware scan on web server

params.message: Isolate web server '{{inputs.host}}' from network? This will take the site offline.
